parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem:
A particle of mass $m$ and charge $+Q$ moves at speed $v$ into a region where there is a uniform magnetic field, as shown in Fig. 7.1.

{{figure:figure_7_1}}

Fig. 7.1

The uniform magnetic field is into the page and has flux density $B$. The particle enters the region of the field at point $Y$.
parts.text: State an expression, in terms of some or all of $m$, $Q$, $B$ and $v$, for the magnetic force $F$ that acts on the particle when it is at point $Y$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: On Fig. 7.1, draw an arrow at point $Y$ to indicate the direction of the force in (b)(i).

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: On Fig. 7.1, draw a line to show a possible path for the particle through the region of the magnetic field.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Explain how an electric field can be used with the magnetic field to ensure that the particle in (b) now passes through point $Z$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Derive an expression for $v$ in terms of $B$ and the electric field strength $E$.
